what: The whole element is covered with an accent-color dot grid (spacing 35 · radius 27±3, overlapping with no gaps), and letter balls (radius 18, bouncing at 6.5px · .007) are scattered over it. When the cursor touches a ball it bursts into 6~9 petals (speed 14~20, shrinking by .93 every frame), and dots within 30px of where a petal passed open into holes over 1000ms, revealing the content underneath (text · photos). With no interaction for 8 seconds one ball bursts on its own, and a burst ball reappears at a different spot 2.6 seconds later

options.word: Letter to place on each ball, default PINGPONG (up to 16 characters)
options.spacing · dot · ball: Dot spacing 35 · dot radius 27 · ball radius 18 (px)
options.idle: Interval (ms) at which it pops on its own when there is no interaction, default 8000 (0 turns it off)
options.grow: Time for all the holes to open (ms), default 1000
options.--fx-dot · --fx-ball · --fx-ink: Dot color (default --kf-accent) · ball and petal color (default --kf-bg) · ball text (default --kf-ink)

note: Cursor-reactive, so on touch devices only the ball at the tapped spot pops (no drag drawing — page scroll is not blocked). With reduced motion, the dot board is not attached and the content is shown as is

from.where: index.js hero canvas — original sketch.js (p5, LGPL, so not brought in and rebuilt from scratch on a canvas): tt_gridSpacing 35 · tt_gridDotRadiusBase 40±8 (diameter) · tt_circleRadius 18 · tt_bounceSpeed .007 · tt_bounceAmplitude 6.5 · 6~9 petals at speed 14~20 · tt_revealDuration 1000 · tt_hoverCooldown 300 · tt_autoTriggerDelay 8000
